capabilities: Evaluate formulas in Markdown tables with a1-style and relative cell references
Expand ranges and brackets as matrices for matrix operations like transpose and determinant
Highlight parent and child cell dependencies on hover with customizable colors
Perform calculations with physical units, including automatic unit conversion
Restrict processing to notes with a specific cssclass
disambiguation: Not a general spreadsheet app; formulas are computed only inside existing Markdown tables and rendered in place.
extras: The README suggests checking the browser console (F12) for debugging and offers cssclass filtering so not every note's tables are processed.
problem: Obsidian tables are static text with no calculation ability, so numeric data in notes must be moved to an external spreadsheet app.
summary: Adds spreadsheet-style formulas with cell references, ranges, matrices, and unit arithmetic to Markdown tables.
